verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Obsidian's Version history feature applies to notes via Obsidian Sync (obsidian-docs-28, obsidian-docs-38), and a community Git plugin is mentioned for backup (obsidian-comm-9), but nothing documents versioning, reviewing, or rolling back 'automations' (plugins, templates, URI-triggered workflows) specifically — no changelog/diff/rollback mechanism for plugin configs or automation scripts is evidenced.
